turns.title: A callback returns to its run
turns.hypothesis: A callback should wake the session that spawned the run rather than other sessions in the same workspace.
turns.attempt: The illustration labels one callback with a run ID and shows two sibling sessions waiting.
turns.result: Only the matching session receives the callback. The illustration explains run-ID-bound delivery; it is not execution evidence.
turns.adaptation: Next, distinguish a clean process exit from a verified task receipt.
turns.story: The callback carries the run ID of the session that requested it.

turns.title: Exit zero is not a task receipt
turns.hypothesis: A child can exit cleanly without proving that it completed the assigned task.
turns.attempt: The illustration separates the process-exit signal from the receipt checked by the verifier.
turns.result: The verifier finds an empty receipt, so Terrarium would classify the run as inconclusive rather than successful.
turns.adaptation: Next, show a parent launching several independent runs as one explicit batch.
turns.story: A zero exit code reports process state. The correlated receipt reports task completion.

turns.title: Three independent runs, one batch
turns.technique: Flat fan-out with a join condition
turns.hypothesis: A batch should expose the parent, its independent runs, and the join condition.
turns.attempt: The illustration shows one parent launching three separate runs and waiting for a quorum of two.
turns.result: Two runs finish and satisfy the quorum. The third remains an ordinary run that can be cancelled or inspected.
turns.adaptation: Next, show how cancellation remains addressable after launch.
turns.story: Batch fan-out creates separate runs, each with its own state and receipt.

turns.title: Verified summaries cannot be blank
turns.hypothesis: The campaign can report a receipt-validation change while keeping the illustration separate from the evidence.
turns.attempt: The illustration shows the verifier rejecting blank summary fields and accepting a populated one.
turns.result: Terrarium rejects a supplied verified-receipt summary when it is empty or not a string. Legacy verified receipts may still omit the summary field.
turns.adaptation: Continue requiring checkable evidence before publishing a product summary.
turns.story: When a verified receipt supplies a summary, the summary must be a non-empty string.

turns.title: Model configuration errors are not retryable
turns.hypothesis: The campaign can distinguish retryable runner failures from model lookup and configuration errors.
turns.attempt: The illustration marks a model configuration error as non-retryable and keeps the retry path separate.
turns.result: Terrarium classifies opencode model lookup and configuration failures as model-configuration with retryable set to false.
turns.adaptation: Classify failures before the loop decides whether to start another child.
turns.story: A model lookup or configuration failure requires a configuration change, not another attempt with the same settings.
